_example: EXAMPLE SPEC, not an ATR Lab project record. It continues the fictional haptic-feedback example from nasa-haptics-example.json; the milestones, dates and statuses are invented to show every status symbol, and the Objective slot carries a brand-font callout (Roboto Slab value, Source Sans 3 label) in place of a photo. Bracketed values are unknowns. Build: python3 scripts/quad_chart.py scripts/examples/quads/status-haptics-example.json -o status-example.pptx --allow-placeholders --check --render
title: Reliable remote grasping over slow networks
objective: Keep remote grasps reliable at up to 500 ms of delay.
A haptic testbed that adapts to the delay.

image.alt: Callout: 31% fewer grasp failures at 500 ms of delay, 24 participants (example value).

approach: Adapt force-feedback timing and gain to the measured delay.
Challenge: stability at 500 ms, handled by [method].
impact: Impact: remote grasping that stays reliable on slow links.
Deliverables: ROS package, study dataset, RA-L paper.
notes: Status markers are shape + written label + color (references/color.md section 6); the typed glyphs use the text-safe colors from quad-layouts.json.
